owner: ROOT/refresh_cleanup_review; implementation only by root assignment
hypothesis: A decoder-learned bounded FIFO word dictionary can replace the whole-input word table while retaining the exact opcode transform and BZip2 backend, and pay for its complete representation and incremental local source on opening250KB.
diagnosed_premise: Explicit dictionary representations can erase repeated-word savings. The preliminary causal sketch gained on a repeated synthetic vocabulary but lost on FIFO eviction; therefore capacity, word lengths and replacement are frozen, and both a reuse fixture and eviction-negative fixture are mandatory. This is independent of parameter-template selection and argument storage.

inputs.role: historical exact archive and package receipt
closed negative argument-token reflection; not a parent source dependency

historical_parent.limitation: Legacy receipt establishes scoped results only. The readable parent was retired for larger packaging, with identical archive bytes to the compact equivalent. This assignment neither selects a qualified parent nor resumes held legacy jobs. A newly frozen comparison must reproduce P.

configuration.replacement: FIFO insertion; hits do not change order
configuration.eligible_word: complete maximal exact ASCII alphabetic run of 5 through 32 bytes
configuration.reference: [1, slot+1], slot in 0..127, only an occupied slot at a whole-word boundary
configuration.frames: one bounded input frame, no cross-frame history

arms.P: unchanged parent archive; separately derived lexical diagnostics
arms.K: same parent payload plus dictionary bookkeeping; P/K must be byte-identical
arms.T: causal FIFO references over parent opcode bytes then unchanged BZip2
arms.L: identical causal dictionary updates and literal escaping with references disabled

codec_limits.decoder_work: bounded input scan, bounded BZip2 output, bounded word expansion, bounded opcode expansion; no recursion or unbounded rule graph

synthetic_requirements: independent encode/decode/repeat with dictionary and transition digest agreement
empty, arbitrary bytes, escaping, malformed markup and maximal word boundaries
FIFO wrap and eviction-negative economic fixture
unknown, adjacent and truncated reference rejection
BZip2 truncation, concatenation, expansion and archive bounds
new-output publication without overwriting existing targets

proposed_corpus_gate.requires: Root review, frozen execution contract, canonical claim, publication, and fresh admission before any corpus execution

package.accounting: Measure the exact new codec and required readable parent source plus any wrapper/options. Compare against the historically counted 1448-byte parent package. No compressed-source savings are assumed. Charge the measured nonnegative local-source increment against both P and L archive deltas as a conservative development screen.

acceptance: All exact inverse, repeat, P/K identity, decoder-derived state and bounds checks pass. The complete T archive plus measured nonnegative incremental local source must be strictly smaller than complete P and complete L archives. Raw displaced bytes or synthetic savings never establish corpus gain.
stop_rule: No tuning after opening250KB. A compression loss, nonpaying source increment or exhausted phase/job budget holds this realization without validation or scale launch. Correctness failures are implementation failures, not scientific rejection; preserve every failure. Validation and 1MB confirmation remain withheld until a separately frozen successor decision.
